privileged_info_for_vlm: The search must be for 'Theory' in the 'Title' field. There are exactly 3 matching papers in the database: 1) 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948), 2) 'An Unsolvable Problem of Elementary Number Theory' (Church, 1936), and 3) 'The Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon & Weaver, 1949). The collection 'Theoretical Foundations' must be a standard folder (static collection), not a Saved Search (dynamic collection).
